regulation_clause.text: 'Officially Valid Document (OVD)' means the passport, the driving licence, proof of possession of Aadhaar number, the Voter's Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India, the job card issued by NREGA duly signed by an officer of the State Government, and the letter issued by the National Population Register containing details of name and address.
